title: Transform Trajectory
text: Generate trajectory between two homogeneous transforms, 6 inputs, 3 outputs, {Time scaling time} sets Time scaling time points; {Waypoint source} sets the source for waypoints, {Initial transform}, {Final transform}, {Time interval} sets the start and end times for trajectory, {Use custom time scaling} enables custom time scaling, {Parameter source} sets the source for waypoints, {Time scaling values} sets the time scaling vector and first two derivatives and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Time
ports.summary: Time point along trajectory scalar | vector

ports.name: TimeInterval
ports.summary: Start and end times for trajectory two-element vector

ports.name: TSTime
ports.summary: Time scaling time points scalar | p -element vector

ports.name: TimeScaling
ports.summary: Time scaling vector and first two derivatives three-element vector | 3-by- p matrix

ports.name: tform
ports.summary: Homogeneous transformation matrices 4-by-4-by- m homogenous matrix array

params.name: Initial transform
params.values: Initial transformation matrix trvec2tform([1 10 -1]) (default) | 4-by-4 homogeneous transformation

params.name: Final transform
params.values: Final transformation matrix eul2tform([0 pi pi/2]) (default) | 4-by-4 homogeneous transformation

params.name: Time interval
params.values: Start and end times for trajectory [2 3] | two-element vector

params.name: Use custom time scaling
params.values: Enable custom time scaling off (default) | on

params.name: Time scaling time
params.values: Time scaling time points 2:0.1:3 (default) | scalar | p -element vector

params.name: Time scaling values
params.values: Time scaling vector and first two derivatives [0:0.1:1; ones(1,11); zeros(1,11)] (default) | three-element vector | 3-by- m matrix

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
